checks.name: question analysis is independent of all card identities and meanings
question analysis carries the original request rather than an inferred domain
malformed plans are rejected without crashing the validator
reading sees raw question and oriented symbols, no old canned answer
original uncertainty remains visible even if model classifies it badly
schema has no fixed question-domain vocabulary

note: Development protocol and source-preservation checks, not semantic accuracy or expert quality. No model output mocked as an actual answer.
